ops.title: The v0.21 flag day closed: every managed agent marked, and the Stop fix proven on a real stale agent
ops.body:
2026-08-16. The daemonkit v0.21 release chain is complete and verified on yasyf-forge. Five releases cut in sequence, each gated on green CI before its tag.

## Releases

| Repo | Version | Commit | Carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| cc-interact | v0.32.1 | `fa30118` | the Program-less `Stop` fix (`2614d0a`) |
| cc-present | v0.32.3 | `dd9fb28` | repin + toolchain |
| cc-review | v0.34.1 | `49829fc` | repin + toolchain |
| cc-orchestrate | v0.16.1 | `1167a38` | repin + toolchain |
| synckit | v0.37.2 | `5c37645` | `serveSpec` argv fix |
| cc-skills (codex) | v1.10.0 | `3235e54` | daemonkit v0.19.1 → v0.21.4 |

## The Stop fix, proven against a real stale agent — not a synthetic one

`com.yasyf.codex-ask` was dead at exit 78 (`EX_CONFIG`), its plist naming `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/codex-ask/1.8.4/codex-ask` after the cask had moved to 1.9.0 and deleted that directory. That is the exact shape the fix exists for: a machine that never ensured this era, where `Stop`'s absence proof resolves a path only `Ensure` ever places.

```
$ codex-ask stop
daemon: stopped                      # rc=0
$ ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.yasyf.codex-ask.plist
No such file or directory            # agent actually removed
```

Pre-fix this same call errored `resolve program … no such file or directory` and left the plist behind, so the surviving agent relaunched the daemon. This is the live reproduction recorded as `ffb9859`, re-run against the released artifact.

## Converging codex-ask needs `direct`, not `status` or `--dispatch`

Neither obvious verb converges a *dead* agent, and this cost time to find:
- `status` calls `EnsureCurrentIfRunning`, which short-circuits on `ErrNoPeer` and prints `daemon: not running`.
- A bare `codex-ask --dispatch` never touches the daemon at all — it returns `REPLY_FILE`/`LOG_FILE`/`AWAIT` and exits.

`directWake` (`plugins/codex/consumer.go:206`) is **the single enqueue path**, calling `EnsureCurrent → NewClient → OpAgentDirect`. It is reached by the `direct` subcommand and by the detached worker's owner wake. So `codex-ask direct --session <s> --agent <a> --origin system "<text>"` is what converges the agent from cold.

## End state — 10 of 10 managed agents marked, every image live

All ten daemonkit-managed LaunchAgents carry `DAEMONKIT_AGENT_OWNER=daemonkit`, and `lsof -a -p <pid> -d txt` shows a live, non-deleted image for every one with a PID. codex-ask now runs `~/.daemonkit/bin/com.yasyf.codex-ask` at PID 35120, status 0.

**`com.yasyf.reap-build-scratch` and `com.yasyf.reap-orphaned-agents` are markerless and always will be** — they are plain `~/.local/bin` shell scripts daemonkit does not manage. Counting them is a mistake worth not repeating: an earlier survey in this session reported "7/7 marked" by including them, and separately counted codex-ask as converged when it was neither marked nor running. Survey with `plutil -p … | sed`, never `grep` — and note that capt-hook's grep-killing guard pack was itself dead at the time, so a `grep`-based survey read as a clean pass.

Two open items at the time of writing: `com.github.yasyf.synckit.helper.{cookiesync,reposync}` show last-exit 1 in `launchctl list` despite holding PIDs, and `com.github.yasyf.synckit.reconcile` is `- 0` (periodic, not running — expected).
